offers_products.reason: Designs and sells UGG, HOKA and Teva footwear, apparel and accessories.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from footwear and apparel goods; no main service offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Shoppers buy UGG, HOKA, Teva through its own stores, e-commerce and retailers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Wholesale to retailers and distributors who resell its brands is a major channel.

recurring_revenue.reason: Footwear sold as individual purchases and seasonal wholesale orders, not subscriptions or contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Premium discretionary footwear and fashion boots can be postponed in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Shoes and boots are small, frequent purchases relative to buyer spending.

people_delivered.reason: Product company selling designed footwear and apparel, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are consumers and retailers; household sales make this no.

asset_heavy.reason: Outsources manufacturing to contract factories; owns some retail stores but is largely asset-light.
